headline: Iran Declares 72-Hour Military Readiness as Israel Strikes Across Multiple Fronts
subheadline: IDF interceptors launch over southern Lebanon while Israeli airstrikes kill two weapon smugglers in Khan Younis and demolish a 1.5 km Hamas tunnel.
lede: Iran declared full military readiness for 72 hours amid escalating multi-front activity across the region. Israeli forces launched interceptor missiles over southern Lebanon, killed two Palestinian weapon smugglers in a Khan Younis airstrike, and demolished a 1.5 km Hamas tunnel crossing the Yellow Line. Meanwhile, Russia unleashed a record wave of Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones across Ukrainian regions, while Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries and the UK pledged additional Storm Shadow missiles.

sections.title: Russia Barrages Ukraine; Kyiv Resumes Oil Strikes
sections.body: Russia launched a record wave of Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones targeting Kyiv, Khmelnytskyi, Rivno, and other regions, causing widespread power outages and civilian casualties. Ukrainian air defense intercepted several targets, but debris damaged residential buildings in Kyiv's Pechersk district, injuring five people. President Zelenskyy announced Ukraine lifted restrictions on striking Russian oil refineries, and the UK confirmed delivery of additional Storm Shadow cruise missiles.

sections.title: Iran Readiness; Israel Strikes Lebanon, Gaza
sections.body: Iran declared full military readiness for the next 72 hours amid escalating regional activity. Israeli forces conducted interceptor launches over southern Lebanon, killed two weapon smugglers in an airstrike in Khan Younis, and demolished a 1.5 km Hamas tunnel crossing the Yellow Line. Syria accused Israel of arming militias in Suwayda, while Iraq appointed Iran-backed militia leader Laith al-Khazali as deputy prime minister.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's declared 72-hour full readiness posture, combined with ballistic missile testing, Tehran air defense activity, and IRGC naval action in the Strait of Hormuz, suggests a coordinated signaling campaign or preparation for kinetic action. Israel's simultaneous interceptor launches, tunnel demolition, and targeted killings indicate high operational tempo across multiple fronts, while Iraq's elevation of a designated terrorist to deputy PM reflects deepening Iranian proxy entrenchment.
